questions.question: Q1. What is the process of organizing data in a database to reduce redundancy and avoid anomalies called?
Q2. In First Normal Form (1NF), every attribute must contain only atomic values and there can be no repeating groups.
Q3. What type of dependency occurs when a non-prime attribute depends on only part of a composite key, violating 2NF?
Q4. Which normal form requires the table to be in 2NF and have no transitive dependency of a non-prime attribute on the key?
Q5. In Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF), for every functional dependency X -> Y, what must X be?
Q6. An update anomaly happens when we cannot add some data without adding other unrelated data.
Q7. What type of anomaly occurs when deleting one row accidentally removes other facts we wanted to keep?
Q8. In the notation of functional dependency, what does X -> Y mean?
